nindian-society-39-10.s: The Vibrant Villages Programme provides reverse-migration incentives in:
nindian-society-39-10.x: The Vibrant Villages Programme is a grassroots development campaign offering reverse-migration incentives in northern border villages.

nc928838f2d9.s: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is implemented at the national level by the:
nc928838f2d9.x: PM-JAY is run by the National Health Authority (NHA); the Ministry of Jal Shakti runs the Jal Jeevan Mission.

nindian-society-39-16.s: The Vibrant Villages Programme is implemented by the Ministry of:
nindian-society-39-16.x: Vibrant Villages is run by the Home Ministry; Nasha Mukt Bharat is under Social Justice and Poshan campaigns under Women and Child Development.

n4d6eb412cae.s: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) is a pension scheme for:
o: Traders with turnover up to ₹1.5 crore
Unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000 a month
Unorganised workers with a bank account
n4d6eb412cae.x: PM-KMY is for small and marginal farmers; traders are covered by NPS-Traders and low-wage unorganised workers by PM-SYM.

necfc2cb74fb.s: Under the NSAP, the National Family Benefit Scheme gives assistance on the death of a breadwinner aged:
necfc2cb74fb.x: NFBS assists the family on the death of a breadwinner aged 18–59; 40–79 is the IGNWPS age band.

na791e48f453.s: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) is a scheme of the Ministry of:
na791e48f453.x: SAGY is under the Ministry of Rural Development; it was launched on 11 October 2014, Jayaprakash Narayan's birth anniversary.

nf8b83c8b207.s: Under PM Vishwakarma, artisans receive toolkit support of up to:
nf8b83c8b207.x: PM Vishwakarma gives artisans in 18 traditional trades a toolkit up to ₹15,000, a ₹500/day training stipend and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh.

n7a827207812.s: Tap water to all households in statutory towns is the objective of:
n7a827207812.x: AMRUT 2.0 (2021) aims at tap water for all households in statutory towns; SBM-Urban 2.0 targets garbage-free cities.

n98e61f08ce3.s: PMKVY 1.0, the flagship of the Skill India Mission, was launched in:
n98e61f08ce3.x: PMKVY 1.0 was launched in 2015 along with the Skill India Mission, not in 2016.

nindian-society-38-13.s: Which platform offers AI-aligned vocational certifications, apprenticeship matchmaking and PMKVY enrolment?
nindian-society-38-13.x: The Skill India Digital Hub offers AI-aligned certificates, apprenticeship matching and PMKVY enrolment.

nfc592bc6f4b.s: Under the MUDRA scheme, the Kishor category covers loans of:
nfc592bc6f4b.x: Kishor covers ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh; Shishu is up to ₹50,000 and Tarun ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.

n25a03e4ba54.s: Which agency is the nodal agency for Saubhagya?
n25a03e4ba54.x: REC is the nodal agency for DDUGJY and Saubhagya; EESL implements UJALA and KVIC handles PMEGP and Solar Charkha.

o: Highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads
nf5e90995716.x: Bharatmala concerns highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads; Sagarmala concerns port-led development.

n84cddd95b3a.s: The Western Dedicated Freight Corridor runs between:
n84cddd95b3a.x: The Western DFC runs Dadri–JNPT; the Eastern DFC runs Ludhiana–Sonnagar/Dankuni. DFCs are built by DFCCIL, not NHAI.

n68f54f5b8ca.s: The nodal ministry of the National Green Hydrogen Mission is the Ministry of:
n68f54f5b8ca.x: The mission is under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), not the Ministry of Power.

nd4ad04d526d.s: The UIDAI, which issues the 12-digit Aadhaar number, works under the:
nd4ad04d526d.x: UIDAI works under the Aadhaar Act, 2016 (amended 2019), not the National Food Security Act.

new.s: Pulse Polio, India's polio eradication campaign, was launched in:
new.x: Pulse Polio began in 1995; WHO certified India polio-free only in 2014.

new.s: PM-ABHIM, which funds critical-care blocks and Integrated Public Health Labs, has an outlay of:
new.x: PM-ABHIM (2021) has an outlay of ₹64,180 crore over 6 years for critical-care blocks, public health labs and pandemic preparedness.

new.s: Janani Suraksha Yojana, under the National Health Mission, was launched in:
new.x: JSY was launched in 2005 under NHM and is 100% centrally sponsored.

new.s: Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission aims to eliminate sickle cell anaemia by:
new.x: The mission, launched at Shahdol in July 2023, targets elimination by 2047.

new.s: Eligibility under PM-JAY uses SECC 2011 deprivation criteria numbering:
new.x: PM-JAY uses 6 rural deprivation and 11 urban occupational criteria from SECC 2011.

new.s: Which earlier scheme was subsumed in Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
new.x: PM-JAY subsumed RSBY (2008); it was earlier called the National Health Protection Scheme.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's state health scheme converged with PM-JAY now runs as:
new.x: AP's scheme, begun as Rajiv Aarogyasri in 2007, now runs as Dr NTR Vaidya Seva converged with PM-JAY.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
o: It was launched on 23 September 2018 at Ranchi
Its general Centre-State funding ratio is 60:40
It is the world's second-largest government-funded health assurance scheme
new.x: PM-JAY is the world's largest, not second-largest, health assurance scheme fully paid by the government.

new.s: The Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) is:
o: A registry of verified medical practitioners
A portal to track TB patients
A unique health ID that links a person's health records
new.x: ABHA is the unique health ID under ABDM linking a person's health records.

new.s: Ni-kshay is a case-based web portal for tracking patients of:
new.x: Ni-kshay tracks TB patients; CoWIN handled COVID-19 vaccination.

new.s: U-WIN, modelled on CoWIN, is an electronic registry of:
o: Routine immunisation of pregnant women and children
new.x: U-WIN records routine immunisation of pregnant women and children under UIP; CoWIN was for COVID-19 vaccines.

new.s: eSanjeevani, India's national telemedicine service, was first rolled out in:
new.x: eSanjeevani (2019) was first rolled out in Andhra Pradesh.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission:
1. It was launched in September 2021.
2. Its Healthcare Professionals Registry covers only modern medicine practitioners.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: ABDM launched in September 2021; the HPR covers practitioners of both modern and traditional systems, so 2 is wrong.

new.s: NIPUN Bharat (2021) aims at foundational literacy and numeracy by:
new.x: NIPUN Bharat targets foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3.

new.s: DIKSHA, launched in 2017, is a national digital platform mainly for:
new.x: DIKSHA is the teachers' platform; SWAYAM offers MOOCs to students and Vidyanjali links schools with volunteers.

new.s: Vidyanjali (2021) is a portal that links government and aided schools with:
new.x: Vidyanjali is the school volunteer portal linking schools with volunteers, NGOs and CSR donors.

new.s: PM SHRI aims to upgrade over 14,500 schools to showcase:
new.x: PM SHRI (Cabinet 7 Sep 2022) upgrades 14,500+ schools as showcases of NEP 2020.

new.s: Samagra Shiksha (2018) merged SSA, RMSA and:
new.x: Samagra Shiksha merged SSA, RMSA and Teacher Education.

new.s: How many people are covered under the National Food Security Act?
new.x: NFSA covers 79.8 crore people; 81.35 crore is the free-grain figure of August 2026.

new.s: Annapurna gives destitute elderly persons free foodgrain of:
new.x: Annapurna gives 10 kg of free grain a month; 35 kg per household is the AAY entitlement.

new.s: The maternity benefit under the National Food Security Act is:
new.x: NFSA provides a maternity benefit of ₹6,000; ₹20,000 is the NFBS lump sum.

new.s: Rashtriya Poshan Maah and Poshan Pakhwada are held respectively in:
new.x: Poshan Maah is held in September and Poshan Pakhwada in March - bi-annual drives, not June/December.

new.s: The India Sanitation Coalition, launched in June 2015 to support Swachh Bharat, was set up by:
new.x: The India Sanitation Coalition was launched by FICCI on 25 June 2015.

new.s: The Swachh Bharat Mission was launched on:
new.x: SBM was launched on 2 October 2014 with the target of a clean India by 2 October 2019.

new.s: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, village water supply is planned and run by:
new.x: Village Water and Sanitation Committees plan and run supply under the Jal Jeevan Mission.

new.s: Rajiv Awas Yojana, aimed at a slum-free India, was subsumed into PMAY-Urban in:
new.x: Rajiv Awas Yojana was subsumed into PMAY-U in 2015.

new.s: PMAY-Urban originally set the target of 'Housing for All' by:
new.x: PMAY-U (2015) originally aimed at Housing for All by 2022.

new.s: The minimum unit size of a house under PMAY-Gramin is:
new.x: PMAY-G houses must be at least 25 sq m.

new.s: The annual premium of Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is:
new.x: PMJJBY costs ₹436 a year (raised from ₹330 from 1 June 2022); ₹20 is the PMSBY premium.

new.s: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides:
o: Life cover of ₹2 lakh for death from any cause
Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family
Accident cover of ₹2 lakh for death or full disability
new.x: PMSBY is an accident scheme: ₹2 lakh for death/full disability, ₹1 lakh for partial; PMJJBY gives life cover.

new.s: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (2007) provides life and disability cover to:
new.x: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana covers rural landless households.

new.s: Ujjwala Yojana, giving free LPG connections to BPL women, was launched on 1 May 2016 at:
new.x: Ujjwala was launched at Ballia (UP); Ranchi was PM-JAY's launch site and Jhunjhunu POSHAN's.

new.s: SEED, the scheme for Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes, is a Central Sector scheme of:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: SEED (2022) is a Central Sector scheme of MoSJE with ₹200 crore over 5 years.

new.s: The regulator of the National Pension System is:
new.x: NPS is regulated by PFRDA, set up under an Act passed in 2013 and notified in 2014.

new.s: The entry age for the Atal Pension Yojana is:
new.x: APY entry age is 18-40; 16-59 is the e-Shram age band.

new.s: Under the Atal Pension Yojana, the monthly pension at 60 ranges from:
new.x: APY gives ₹1,000-5,000 a month from own contribution; PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders give ₹3,000.

new.s: Under the NSAP, IGNDPS covers persons aged 18-79 with disability of at least:
new.x: IGNDPS covers persons with disability of 80% or more.

new.s: The National Family Benefit Scheme pays a lump sum of:
new.x: NFBS pays ₹20,000 on the death of a breadwinner aged 18-59.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Pension System:
1. Overseas Citizens of India may join it.
2. An account can be opened for a third person.
3. Tier I is mandatory and Tier II voluntary.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: OCIs may join and Tier I is mandatory, Tier II voluntary; an NPS account cannot be opened or run for a third person.

new.s: The employee's contribution to EPF is generally:
new.x: EPF contributions are 12% each from employer and employee (10% in notified establishments).

new.s: Under the Code on Social Security, aggregators contribute 1-2% of turnover, capped at:
new.x: Aggregators pay 1-2% of turnover, capped at 5% of payouts to gig and platform workers.

new.s: Which of the following is excluded from registering on e-Shram?
new.x: e-Shram excludes income-tax payers and EPFO/ESIC members; it covers unorganised workers aged 16-59.

new.s: Maternity leave under the Code on Social Security, 2020 is:
new.x: The Code provides 26 weeks of maternity leave.

new.s: Which of the following is an example of social insurance rather than social assistance?
new.x: Social insurance is contributory and tied to employment (EPF, ESI, APY, PM-SYM); NSAP, NFSA and PM-JAY are tax-funded social assistance.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about ILO Convention No. 102:
1. It was adopted in 1952.
2. India has ratified it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: C102, the Social Security (Minimum Standards) Convention, dates from 1952; India has not ratified it.

new.s: Which of the following schemes was launched earliest?
new.x: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana dates from 2007; APY and PMSBY from 9 May 2015 and PM-JAY from September 2018.

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order of launch:
1. PM-JAY
2. Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
3. Atal Pension Yojana
4. e-Shram
new.x: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (2007), APY (2015), PM-JAY (2018), e-Shram (2021).

new.s: 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'Per Drop More Crop' are associated with:
new.x: PMKSY (2015) has the slogans 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'Per Drop More Crop'.

new.s: Atal Bhujal Yojana, for community groundwater management in seven water-stressed States, is assisted by:
new.x: Atal Bhujal Yojana (Dec 2019) is World Bank-assisted; the World Bank also supports SANKALP.

new.s: PM-KISAN provides landholding farmers:
new.x: PM-KISAN gives ₹6,000 a year in 3 instalments; ₹3,000 a month is the Maandhan pension.

new.s: The lead agency for e-NAM, the online national agricultural market, is:
new.x: e-NAM (April 2016) links APMCs online, with SFAC as lead agency.

new.s: Under PMFBY, the farmer premium for kharif crops is:
new.x: PMFBY premium is 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.

new.s: The National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) began in:
new.x: NREP began in 1980, not 1983; RLEGP is 1983.

new.s: Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY, 2001) was formed by merging:
new.x: SGRY merged EAS and JGSY; JRY merged NREP and RLEGP.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the six rural components of Bharat Nirman (2005)?
new.x: Bharat Nirman covered irrigation, roads, housing, drinking water, electrification and telephony - not skilling.

new.s: TRYSEM and DWCRA were sub-programmes of:
new.x: TRYSEM and DWCRA were sub-programmes of IRDP, the Sixth Plan self-employment scheme.

new.s: Under MGNREGA, the social audit of works was conducted by the:
new.x: The Gram Sabha ran MGNREGA social audits; Gram Panchayats planned and carried out works.

new.s: Under MGNREGA, unemployment allowance was payable if work was not given within:
new.x: MGNREGA allowance was due if work was not given within 15 days, paid by States.

new.s: MGNREGA is linked to which Sustainable Development Goals?
new.x: MGNREGA links to SDG 1 (No Poverty) and SDG 8 (Decent Work).

new.s: The general Centre-State funding ratio under VB-G RAM G is:
new.x: VB-G RAM G is a CSS with 60:40 funding (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States).

new.s: MPLADS is administered by the:
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
new.x: MPLADS (1993) is under MoSPI; its funds are non-lapsable.

new.s: Hariyali (2003) is a scheme for:
new.x: Hariyali (2003) is watershed development through Panchayati Raj Institutions.

new.s: SVAMITVA was launched on 24 April 2020, which is observed as:
new.x: SVAMITVA was launched on National Panchayati Raj Day, 24 April 2020.

new.s: PMEGP (2008) was formed by merging:
new.x: PMEGP merged REGP and PMRY; KVIC is its nodal agency.

new.s: Stand-Up India gives bank loans for greenfield enterprises in the range of:
new.x: Stand-Up India loans range from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore, with at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per branch.

new.s: PM-AJAY, for SC-majority villages, is a scheme of the Ministry of:
new.x: PM-AJAY is under the Ministry of Social Justice; PM Vishwakarma is under MSME.

new.s: How many cities are covered under the Smart Cities Mission?
new.x: The Smart Cities Mission covers 100 cities; HRIDAY covers 12.

new.s: PM e-Bus Sewa (2023) aims to provide:
new.x: PM e-Bus Sewa provides 10,000 e-buses for city services on PPP.

new.s: Which of the following is one of the 12 HRIDAY heritage cities?
new.x: HRIDAY's 12 cities include Amaravati (AP) and Warangal.

new.s: RSETIs under the Ministry of Rural Development provide training for:
new.x: RSETIs give self-employment training; DDU-GKY is placement-linked skilling.

new.s: The nodal ministry for PMKVY is:
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
new.x: PMKVY, the Skill India flagship, is under MSDE.

new.s: The apex body of Mission Karmayogi is the:
new.x: Mission Karmayogi's apex body is the PM's Public HR Council; the Capacity Building Commission and Karmayogi Bharat sit below it.

new.s: The iGOT Karmayogi online platform is run by the SPV:
new.x: Karmayogi Bharat, a Section 8 company (2022), runs iGOT Karmayogi.

new.s: FutureSkills Prime, a reskilling platform in emerging technologies, is a joint initiative of:
new.x: FutureSkills Prime is by MeitY and NASSCOM, delivered with C-DAC and NIELIT centres.

new.s: Mission Karmayogi seeks to shift civil-service training from:
new.x: Mission Karmayogi (2020) aims at a shift from rule-based to role-based training.

new.s: Which of the following is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
new.x: DAY-NRLM is Centrally Sponsored; PM-KISAN, PM Vishwakarma and DILRMP (since 2016) are Central Sector.

new.s: Under MPLADS, the earmarks for SC and ST areas are respectively:
new.x: MPLADS earmarks 15% for SC and 7.5% for ST areas.

new.s: Make in India was launched in:
new.x: Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014.

new.s: Atmanirbhar Bharat was launched in:
new.x: Atmanirbhar Bharat dates from May 2020.

new.s: Startup India was launched on:
new.x: Startup India began on 16 January 2016; 1 July 2015 is Digital India and 25 September 2014 Make in India.

new.s: The nodal ministry for the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana is the Ministry of:
new.x: MUDRA is under the Finance Ministry, not MSME; refinance goes through SIDBI.

new.s: The MUDRA 'Tarun Plus' category, introduced in 2024, covers loans of:
new.x: Tarun Plus covers ₹10-20 lakh, only for borrowers who repaid a Tarun loan.

new.s: The National Logistics Policy was launched in:
new.x: The National Logistics Policy (2022) aims to cut logistics cost through integrated digital systems.

new.s: Under Startup India, a startup can exit within:
new.x: Startup India offers exit in 90 days, a 3-year tax holiday and a ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds.

new.s: The three certification levels of the ZED scheme for MSMEs are:
new.x: ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) certification has Bronze, Silver and Gold levels.

new.s: PM-DevINE is funded:
new.x: PM-DevINE, of the Ministry of DoNER, is fully centrally funded and covers all eight NE States.

new.s: PM-DevINE is a scheme of the Ministry of:
new.x: PM-DevINE is under the Ministry of DoNER, announced in Budget 2022-23.

new.s: UDAN, the regional connectivity scheme, belongs to the Ministry of:
new.x: UDAN (2016) is a Ministry of Civil Aviation scheme with capped fares and viability gap funding.

new.s: Sagarmala, the port-led development programme, was launched in:
new.x: Sagarmala dates from 2015; Bharatmala (highways) from 2017.

new.s: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana offers rooftop-solar households up to how many free units a month?
new.x: PM Surya Ghar (Feb 2024, MNRE) gives up to 300 free units a month to 1 crore households.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a green hydrogen hub under the National Green Hydrogen Mission?
new.x: The hubs are Kandla, Paradip and Tuticorin; Haldia is not one.

new.s: The green hydrogen production target for 2030 under the National Green Hydrogen Mission is:
new.x: The mission targets 5 MMTA of green hydrogen by 2030.

new.s: Component B of PM-KUSUM provides for:
new.x: Component B targets 17.5 lakh standalone solar pumps; A is 10 GW plants and C solarises 10 lakh grid pumps.

new.s: The India Semiconductor Mission (2021) is under the:
new.x: ISM and the IndiaAI Mission are under MeitY; ONDC is DPIIT and PM-WANI DoT.

new.s: The first and last of Digital India's nine pillars are respectively:
o: Broadband Highways and IT for Jobs
new.x: Digital India's nine pillars run from Broadband Highways to Early Harvest.

new.s: BharatNet began as:
new.x: BharatNet, fibre broadband to all gram panchayats, began as NOFN.

new.s: Kopparthy in YSR Kadapa is a node of which industrial corridor?
new.x: Kopparthy is on the Visakhapatnam–Chennai corridor, developed with ADB.

new.s: Orvakal in Kurnool is a node of which industrial corridor?
new.x: Orvakal is on the Hyderabad–Bengaluru corridor; Krishnapatnam is on Chennai–Bengaluru.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor is being developed with the assistance of:
new.x: VCIC is developed with the Asian Development Bank.

new.s: IREDA is primarily the financing arm for:
new.x: IREDA finances renewable energy for MNRE; NHAI runs Bharatmala and SIDBI refinances MUDRA.

new.s: Which agency is the nodal agency for PMEGP and Solar Charkha?
new.x: KVIC handles PMEGP and Solar Charkha.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: U-WIN – Routine immunisation of pregnant women and children
new.x: U-WIN records routine immunisation; CoWIN was for COVID-19 vaccines, Ni-kshay tracks TB and eSanjeevani is telemedicine.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: SWAYAM offers MOOCs from Class 9 to postgraduate level
DIKSHA is a platform mainly for teachers
Operation Blackboard was launched under NPE 1986
NIPUN Bharat targets literacy and numeracy by Grade 5
new.x: NIPUN Bharat targets foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3, not Grade 5.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Programme – Nodal ministry) is wrongly matched?
o: POSHAN Abhiyaan – Women and Child Development
new.x: e-Shram is under the Ministry of Labour and Employment; the other pairs are correct.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about PMAY-Gramin:
1. It was restructured from Indira Awaas Yojana.
2. It has been extended up to 2028-29.
3. Unit assistance is ₹1.30 lakh in the plains.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PMAY-G came from Indira Awaas Yojana and runs to 2028-29; unit assistance is ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly areas.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the ESI scheme:
1. The wage ceiling is ₹21,000 a month.
2. It provides PF, EPS pension and EDLI insurance.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: ESI's ceiling is ₹21,000 and it gives medical, sickness and maternity benefits; PF, EPS and EDLI are EPFO benefits.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Scheme – Monthly pension) is wrongly matched?
new.x: NPS-Traders, like PM-SYM and PM-KMY, gives ₹3,000 a month at 60.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: PM-PRANAM (2023) aims to cut chemical fertiliser use; Soil Health Card was launched at Suratgarh, Maandhan pays ₹3,000 a month and e-NAM dates from 2016.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about MGNREGA:
1. One-third of the workers had to be women.
2. Works were planned and carried out by the Gram Panchayat.
3. It has been repealed by VB-G RAM G.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: one-third women, Gram Panchayat implementation, and repeal by VB-G RAM G.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about urban programmes?
o: PM SVANidhi is a scheme of MoHUA
new.x: HRIDAY covers 12 heritage cities; the Smart Cities Mission covers 100.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Programme – Ministry) is wrongly matched?
o: MY Bharat – Youth Affairs and Sports
new.x: Skill India Digital Hub is under MSDE, not Education.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission:
1. It was launched in 2016.
2. Its Centre-State funding share is 60:40.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: SPMRM (2016) develops 300+ Rurban clusters with 60:40 Centre-State funding.

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order of launch:
1. Startup India
2. Make in India
3. Atmanirbhar Bharat
4. Digital India
new.x: Make in India 2014, Digital India 2015, Startup India 2016, Atmanirbhar Bharat 2020.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about MUDRA:
1. Its loans are collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh.
2. Refinance is provided through NABARD.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: MUDRA loans are collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh; refinance is through SIDBI, not NABARD.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PM Gati Shakti?
o: It is a National Master Plan for multimodal connectivity
It is a regional air-connectivity scheme
new.x: Regional air connectivity is UDAN; PM Gati Shakti is a GIS-based National Master Plan.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Programme – Ministry/Department) is wrongly matched?
new.x: The India Semiconductor Mission is under MeitY.
